verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a business communications platform that stores messages, call recordings and transcripts, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention settings and no deletion of messages, calls, transcripts or account data. The only deletion mentioned is revoking API keys, which is an adjacent credential-management control, not data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
